CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS  Wednesday, June 2, 2021
CITY COUNCIL  Special Meeting, 6:00 PM

Victor Farfan, Mayor Pro Tem
Jesse Alvarado, Council Member  Linda Hollinsworth, Interim City Manager
Myra Maravilla, Council Member  Luis Roa, Mayor  Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney
Maria Teresa Del Rio, Council Member

  MINUTES
CALL TO ORDER

Mayor Roa called the Special City Council meeting on Wednesday, June 2, 2021 at approximately
6:01 PM.

INVOCATION

The invocation was led by Mayor Roa.

FLAG SALUTE

The flag salute was led by Mayor Roa.

ROLL CALL
PRESENT
  Mayor Pro Tem Farfan
  Mayor Roa
  Councilmember Alvarado
  Councilmember Maravilla
  Councilmember Del Rio
ABSENT
  None

Reanna Guzman, Staff Assistant I, announced a quorum.

PUBLIC COMMENTS ­ GENERAL OR ITEMS ON OR OFF THE AGENDA

There were no Public Comments at this time.

CLOSED SESSION
1.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE APPOINTMENT (Recruitment)
  PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54957
  Title: City Manager

2.  CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR

Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney, read the Closed Session items into the record.
The City Council recessed at approximately 6:05 PM.
 Reanna Guzman, Staff Assistant I, announced a quorum.

PUBLIC COMMENTS ­ GENERAL OR ITEMS ON OR OFF THE AGENDA

There were no Public Comments at this time.

CLOSED SESSION
1.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE APPOINTMENT (Recruitment)
  PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54957
  Title: City Manager

2.  CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR
  PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54957.6
  Agency Designated Representatives: Luis Roa, Mayor; Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney
  Unrepresented Employee: City Manager

Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney, read the Closed Session items into the record.
The City Council recessed at approximately 6:05 PM.
The City Council reconvened from Closed Session at approximately 8:28 PM.
Reanna Guzman, Staff Assistant I, conducted a roll call and announced a quorum.
Megan Garibaldi, City Attorney, stated there was no reportable action.

ADJOURNMENT

Mayor Roa adjourned the Special City Council meeting at approximately 8:27 PM to the next
Regular City Council meeting to be held on Tuesday, June 8, 2021 at 6:00 PM.
